title.purpose: Screen headings, the dock clock, the receipt amount.

body.purpose: Rows, hints and action buttons (17 to 20px).

eyebrow.purpose: Uppercase kickers like FOCUS SESSION and NOW PLAYING.

keycap.purpose: Names the physical button a control shares: Back, M.

motion.name: preset-flash
motion.purpose: On-screen tab feedback for a physical preset press.

motion.name: screen-enter
motion.purpose: Every screen and toast on mount; screensaver uses 400ms.

motion.name: mode-tap-fill
motion.purpose: End Focus fills while an M tap waits out the go-home window.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: Today's total rises to its new value.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{background:var(--color-accent,#3b82f6);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:14px;padding:16px 48px;font-family:-apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 4px 12px color-mix(in srgb,#3b82f6 45%,transparent);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 100ms ease,filter 100ms ease}.ds-btn-primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f5f6f7;outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:scale(0.96);filter:brightness(0.9)}

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: End Focus and other destructive actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger{background:color-mix(in srgb,#e74c3c 14%,#16191d);color:var(--color-busy,#e74c3c);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,#e74c3c 45%,#262b31);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 48px;font-family:-apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 100ms ease,filter 100ms ease}.ds-btn-danger:hover{filter:brightness(1.15)}.ds-btn-danger:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #e74c3c;outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-danger:active{transform:scale(0.96);filter:brightness(0.9)}

components.name: Status Tabs
components.description: Presets 1-3 as status tabs; the current status is lit solid with dark text.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:3px;background:#0b0d10;padding-bottom:16px}.ds-tab{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:9px 4px;border:none;border-radius:0 0 8px 8px;background:#16191d;color:#f5f6f7;font-family:-apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 100ms ease,filter 100ms ease}.ds-av{background:color-mix(in srgb,#2ecc71 22%,#16191d)}.ds-bz{background:color-mix(in srgb,#e74c3c 22%,#16191d)}.ds-fc{background:color-mix(in srgb,#3b82f6 22%,#16191d)}.ds-av.ds-lit{background:#2ecc71;color:#0b0d10}.ds-tab:hover{filter:brightness(1.15)}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f5f6f7;outline-offset:-3px}.ds-tab:active{transform:scale(0.93);filter:brightness(1.3)}

components.name: Today Total and Ledger
components.description: Home leads with the day total, its meta, and deletable ledger rows.

components.css: .ds-home{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;background:#0b0d10;padding:16px 28px;font-family:-apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif}.ds-total{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-bottom:6px;color:#f5f6f7}.ds-num{font-size:72px;font-weight:800;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;color:#8a9099;font-size:18px;font-weight:600}.ds-meta span:first-child{font-size:20px;font-weight:700}.ds-meta b{color:#f5f6f7;font-weight:800}.ds-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:52px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #262b31;background:#16191d;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.2);font-family:inherit;font-size:17px;text-align:left;color:#f5f6f7;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 100ms ease,border-color 150ms ease}.ds-row i{font-style:normal;color:#8a9099;width:20px;text-align:center}.ds-k{font-weight:700;color:#3b82f6}.ds-s{flex:1;color:#8a9099;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-d{font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-sel{border-color:#3b82f6;background:color-mix(in srgb,#3b82f6 15%,#16191d)}.ds-row:hover{border-color:#3b82f6}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #3b82f6;outline-offset:2px}.ds-row:active{transform:scale(0.96)}

components.css: .ds-rc{width:444px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:14px 16px 0;overflow:hidden;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,#2ecc71 45%,#262b31);background:color-mix(in srgb,#2ecc71 16%,#16191d);box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.4);color:#f5f6f7;font-family:-apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif}.ds-rh{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}.ds-rh b{font-size:26px;font-weight:800;line-height:1}.ds-rh span:last-child{font-size:18px;font-weight:700}.ds-ck{align-self:center;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:999px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#2ecc71;color:#0b0d10;font-size:16px}.ds-rs,.ds-rf span{padding-left:38px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:rgb(245 246 247/.72)}.ds-rf{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.ds-rf span{padding-left:38px}.ds-un{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:40px;padding:0 14px 0 18px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255/.18);background:rgb(0 0 0/.28);color:#f5f6f7;font-family:inherit;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 100ms ease}.ds-un:hover{background:rgb(0 0 0/.4)}.ds-un:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f5f6f7;outline-offset:2px}.ds-un:active{transform:scale(0.96)}.ds-kc{padding:2px 7px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 40%,transparent);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em;opacity:.8}.ds-dr{height:3px;margin:8px -16px 0;background:rgb(245 246 247/.45);transform-origin:left;animation:ds-drain 8s linear infinite}@keyframes ds-drain{from{transform:scaleX(1)}to{transform:scaleX(0)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-dr{animation:none}}

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Jira project-key filter above the issue list.
components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;gap:6px;background:#0b0d10;padding:12px}.ds-chip{border:1px solid #262b31;background:#16191d;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px;font-family:-apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#8a9099;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 100ms ease,border-color 150ms ease}.ds-chip-on{border-color:#3b82f6;background:color-mix(in srgb,#3b82f6 20%,#16191d);color:#f5f6f7}.ds-chip:hover{border-color:#3b82f6}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #3b82f6;outline-offset:2px}.ds-chip:active{transform:scale(0.96)}

components.name: Now-Playing Chip
components.description: Dock widget for the phone Spotify track, with equalizer bars.
components.css: .ds-np{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:420px;height:56px;padding:7px 16px 7px 7px;border:1px solid #262b31;background:#16191d;border-radius:14px;color:#f5f6f7;text-align:left;font-family:-apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 100ms ease}.ds-np-art{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b82f6,#0b0d10);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}.ds-np-text{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.2}.ds-np-text b{font-size:16px}.ds-np-text small{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#8a9099}.ds-eq{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;height:16px}.ds-eq i{width:3px;height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:#2ecc71;animation:ds-eq 900ms ease-in-out infinite}.ds-eq i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:-300ms}.ds-eq i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:-600ms}@keyframes ds-eq{0%,100%{height:4px}50%{height:16px}}.ds-np:hover{border-color:#3b82f6}.ds-np:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #3b82f6;outline-offset:2px}.ds-np:active{transform:scale(0.96)}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-eq i{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Deskbar is a purpose-built gadget, not a web page that happens to be small. The screen is a fixed 800x480 landscape pane read at arm's length, framed by physical hardware: four preset buttons above it, a rotary dial over its top-right corner, a Back button, and a Mode button. The design treats that hardware as part of the interface. The preset tabs hang from the top edge as if the buttons' own material continued into the glass, presses on hardware flash their on-screen twins, the dial's current target is always lit in Focus Blue, and controls name their physical twin with a small keycap.
 The instrument's reading is the day's logged time. Home leads with today's total and a ledger of today's worklogs; status rides in the preset tabs, lit in its signal color. The surface is near-black and dense, with large, chunky, rounded controls that shrink under a finger. Color is signal: the three status hues mean Available, Busy and Focus, and appear at full strength only where that meaning is the point. Everything else is graphite panels, steel edges and slate text. The one place the instrument loosens up is the now-playing player, which washes the whole screen in the album art's own color.
keyCharacteristics: Today's logged time is the largest thing on Home; status is a lit preset tab.
Chunky, finger-sized, rounded controls with a press-shrink response.
Preset tabs flush to the top edge, mirroring the physical buttons above the screen.
Every action has a physical path, and on-screen keycaps name it.
Status color carries meaning; the chrome is neutral.
Bottom-anchored persistent UI; nothing in the top-right corner, interactive or meant to be read.
System sans at heavy weights, tabular numerals for every time value.

rules.name: The Signal Lamp Rule
rules.body: Green, red and blue mean Available, Busy and Focus. Never use them decoratively; red also means destructive or error, green also means success or time logged.

rules.name: The Tint, Don't Fill Rule
rules.body: Outside a lit status tab and the primary button, a signal color appears as a tint mixed into graphite (14 to 30%) with a 45% border, not as a solid fill.

rules.name: The Dial Points Blue Rule
rules.body: Whatever the dial will act on is marked in Focus Blue: a blue border plus a 15 to 20% tint, the same box on issue rows, ledger rows and the duration.

rules.name: The Dark-On-Lamp Rule
rules.body: Text on a solid signal fill is Control Black. White on Go Green is about 2:1, and white on the red and blue fills sits under 4:1.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every clock, countdown, duration, total and scrubber time uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so digits never jitter.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: Titles and summaries that may run long stay on one line: ellipsis in lists, a slow pan (ScrollText) where the full text matters.

dos: Do make today's logged time the largest reading on Home.
Do mirror every physical preset with a flush top tab and flash it on press.
Do give every primary action a physical path, and name it with a keycap when it isn't the obvious one.
Do mark the dial's current target in Focus Blue (border plus tint).
Do keep persistent and interactive UI in the bottom band or on the left side.
Do use tabular numerals for every time value.
Do give every button the 0.96 press-shrink.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion`: the receipt rise, its drain line, the M fill, the count-up and the text pan.
donts: Don't place anything in the top-right corner that has to be pressed or read; the dial and bridgething's toasts own it.
Don't put white text on a solid Go Green, Stop Red or Focus Blue fill.
Don't use Go Green, Stop Red or Focus Blue for anything that doesn't carry their meaning.
Don't wrap titles or issue summaries; a wrap pushes actions into the dock.
Don't add a light theme or responsive breakpoints; the screen is fixed dark 800x480.
Don't use translucent edge colors outside the now-playing player and the receipt.
